articles.title: Rapido’s Manasvi Mann Gets Representation On National Gig Workers' Welfare Panel
articles.description: The Government of India has constituted the National Social Security Board for gig and platform workers, bringing together representatives from digital platforms, worker organisations, government bodies and policy experts to discuss social protection measures for the country's growing gig workforce. The constitution of the Board was formally announced through an Extraordinary Gazette notification by the Ministry of Labour and Employment. Manasvi Mann, General Counsel and Head of Corporate Affairs and Public Policy at Rapido, has been nominated as a member. Rapido is the only app-based passenger mobility aggregator among the five platform companies selected for representation. Manasvi Mann to Represent Rapido on National Board The Board comprises representatives from digital platforms, worker organisations, central and state governments, and subject-matter experts. It will contribute to the development and implementation of social security and welfare measures for gig and platform workers. Mann's nomination gives Rapido an opportunity to represent the app-based passenger mobility sector in discussions on worker welfare and social protection, alongside other industry and government representatives. Focus on Welfare of Platform-Based Workers Platform-based services have become an important source of livelihood across India. In the passenger mobility segment, bike-taxi, auto and cab services provide earning opportunities to individuals while raising specific considerations around financial security and access to welfare benefits. The Board will address the broader requirements of workers engaged in these services and other segments of the platform economy. Industry Participation in Gig Economy Discussions Rapido's inclusion provides an opportunity for the passenger mobility sector to bring its operational experience and industry perspective into national-level discussions. The participation of platform companies alongside worker organisations and government representatives is intended to ensure that different stakeholder perspectives are considered while developing social protection measures. As gig and platform-based employment continues to expand, access to welfare benefits and financial security remains an important consideration for workers across the sector.
